manifest.description: Baseline 7-agent sequential IT incident triage and remediation workflow.
optimization_opportunities: Dynamic routing for simple vs complex incidents
Bypassing symptom diagnostic branch for low-complexity / known-issue incidents
Parallel execution of runbook retrieval and symptom correlation
Early stopping when runbook confidence exceeds 0.95 and severity is SEV-4

agents.name: Diagnostic & Symptom Correlation Specialist
agents.pruning_candidate: Can be bypassed by optimizer for Simple incidents

raw.name: Diagnostic & Symptom Correlation Specialist

agent_constructors.goal: Normalize raw incident ticket text, extract affected services, symptoms, timestamps, and impacted users, and flag any missing critical fields without inventing facts.
agent_constructors.backstory: You are a Tier-1 SRE Intake Specialist. You parse messy, emergency incident tickets into crisp, unambiguous facts and telemetry without speculating or adding unsupported assumptions.

agent_constructors.goal: Categorize the incident into a precise failure domain (network_failure, application_error, authentication_issue, database_problem, storage_exhaustion) and assess complexity level (Simple, Moderate, Complex) for dynamic routing.
agent_constructors.backstory: You are a Senior Systems Architect who excels at recognizing system failure topologies, root failure domains, and whether an incident is standard or multi-service complex.

agent_constructors.goal: Examine candidate runbooks from the local knowledge base, evaluate symptom matches, and select the optimal runbook IDs with supporting evidence.
agent_constructors.backstory: You are an Operations Reliability Engineer who knows every standard operating procedure and selects the most relevant, proven runbook for active incidents.
